intro: Jobs similar to neurologists are other physician specialties and advanced clinical roles. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are General Internal Medicine Physicians (86% similar), rehabilitation medicine physicians (85%) and Nurse Practitioners (85%).
shared: These careers share detailed exams, interpreting tests and managing long-term conditions with patients and families. O*NET rates complex problem solving and social perceptiveness at 4.12 out of 5 for neurologists, and judgment at 4. Internal medicine, allergy, preventive medicine and clinical neuropsychology rely on the same thinking. All 20 need graduate training, and 5 pay more than the $248,560 neurologist median.

faq.q: Which jobs like neurologist pay more?
faq.a: 5 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Emergency Medicine Physicians earn $335,550 (35% more), Dermatologists $328,730 (32% more) and Obstetricians and Gynecologists $292,910 (18% more), according to BLS May 2025 data. Each requires a separate residency, so switching usually means years of extra training.

faq.q: Are there non-physician jobs similar to neurology?
faq.a: Yes. Clinical Neuropsychologists are 85% similar and study how the brain affects behavior, with a median of $110,840 for their broader group. Nurse Practitioners are also 85% similar and earn $132,300, which is 47% less than neurologists, and some specialize in neurology.
